evaluationProtocol.semanticPassRequires: Complete ordered runtime turns, runtime/model identity, tool observations, and a named human reviewer with one verdict and review notes covering every rubric item. Fixture validation and runtime success are not semantic acceptance.
evaluationProtocol.multiTurnReplay: Run turns in order in the same conversation; preserve actual assistant replies and tool observations. Never concatenate user turns or substitute scripted assistant replies.
evaluationProtocol.legacyRunner: evaluate-chickenbro-research.py supports the original three single-turn cases only for this protocol; select their case IDs explicitly. It does not replay turns.
evaluationProtocol.boundedRun: Real model/cloud execution requires separate authorization with explicit case IDs, per-turn timeout and finite total spend; this offline evaluator never invokes a model.
